chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulaym al-Farra' from Hariz from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who permits the private part of his slave girl to his brother, he (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no harm in that.' I said: 'But he has impregnated her.' He said: 'He keeps the child for himself and returns the slave girl to her master.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man allowing his brother to have intercourse with his slave girl and the status of the child?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the rules of *Tamlik al-Sharth* (conditional ownership) regarding a master permitting his brother to have intercourse with his slave girl. The ruling establishes that paternity follows the act of impregnation, so the child belongs to the brother, while the woman’s ownership remains with the original master, reflecting the nuanced juristic distinctions in Shia fiqh regarding concubinage and lineage.
